subject: Marketplace vendor onboarding — connectivity & entitlements for StratusGrid
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@stratusgrid.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace intake — connectivity & entitlements prep

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on — StratusGrid is ready to start marketplace onboarding (AWS/Azure/GCP). Before we kick off the formal intake, procurement asked me to confirm the precise connectivity and entitlement artifacts you need so we can pull them from our internal teams.

High-level asks from our side:
- List of required network inbound/outbound rules for hosted integration (IPs, ports, protocols)
- Entitlement matrix: what entitlements Redwood requires for each marketplace (billing, listing, private offers)
- Exact PO format Redwood prefers and any mandatory line items for marketplace listings
- Compliance evidence required for the marketplace activation (SOC2, encryption, data residency LOCs)

Can you confirm the above and send any templates (network whitelist template, entitlement spreadsheet, sample PO) so procurement can prep a single package? We aim to have everything to you by EOD Friday (Jul 25).

Attached: brief vendor overview (see stub).

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Head of Cloud Partnerships, StratusGrid
[attachment: stratusgrid_onboarding_onepager.pdf]
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@stratusgrid.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace intake — connectivity & entitlements prep

Hi Aisha — great to meet you (virtually). Short answers up front, then a quick checklist and templates attached.

Yes — please bundle everything into one upload and label items with the marketplace they apply to (AWS / Azure / GCP). Our procurement flow needs the following minimum artifacts: 
1) Completed entitlement_matrix.xlsx (attached template) — include marketplace-specific SKUs and whether you plan to support private offers.
2) Sample purchase order (sample_po_stratusgrid.docx) — include legal entity name and preferred billing address. We accept Net30 or Net45; finance will confirm the final term based on account risk profile.
3) Network whitelist: provide public IPs, expected egress destinations, and ports. Use the network_whitelist_template.txt attached.
4) Compliance bundle: SOC2 report (redacted ok), privacy addendum if applicable, and a short note on data residency.
5) Marketplace listing owner contact and technical contact for onboarding calls.

Quick notes:
- For AWS and GCP we need the marketplace entitlements that enable private listings (if you plan to use them) — please mark those columns in the entitlement matrix.
- Azure often requires a marketplace-specific publisher ID; include that if you have it.
- If you expect to use metered billing, include a sample usage file or explain the expected crediting flow.

Attachments: entitlement_matrix.xlsx, network_whitelist_template.txt, sample_po_stratusgrid.docx

Next step: procurement sends the completed packet to naomi_feldman@redwood.com. Naomi — can you confirm the PO number format and whether there are any additional mandatory billing line items we need to enforce for marketplace-enabled offers?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@stratusgrid.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace intake — connectivity & entitlements prep

Vanessa — thanks for the clear checklist and templates. A few follow-ups from procurement/engineering as they start filling things out:

1) On the entitlement matrix: our product team needs a definition of "private offers enabled" vs "publisher-managed billing" in Redwood terms — does enabling private offers require any additional signed agreement or just marketplace flags?

2) For network whitelists: we have dynamic egress IPs behind a NAT gateway for some customers. Is Redwood able to accept an ASN range or do you require fixed IPs for production?

3) Compliance: attaching our standard cert pack; SOC2 is redacted and we can provide an LOE on data residency.

Attached: vendor_certifications.pdf

We'll aim to send back the completed packet by Thu EOD Pacific.

Best,
Aisha
[attachment: vendor_certifications.pdf]
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@stratusgrid.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace intake — connectivity & entitlements prep

Hi Aisha — Naomi on Redwood Finance. Quick clarifications from the finance side so your procurement can fill the PO correctly:

- PO number format: RW-YYYY-#### (we will issue our internal PO once the SOW is agreed; your sample PO should include your legal entity name, tax ID, and preferred billing address).
- Billing terms: we can accept Net30 or Net45. If you have an existing relationship with Redwood (previous marketplace or direct contract), please indicate so on the sample PO — that may allow us to match prior terms.
- Mandatory line items for marketplace: please include a single line that maps your SKU to the marketplace product ID and unit description (example: "StratusGrid Compute SKU S-GRID-001 — Marketplace listing: AWS-ml-x1").
- Invoices should reference the Redwood invoice address and include the marketplace purchase order ID when applicable.

If you can include those fields on the sample_po_stratusgrid.docx and return to procurement@stratusgrid.com, we will accelerate the routing.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@stratusgrid.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace intake — connectivity & entitlements prep (Action plan)

Thanks all — summary and action items below so we have a single mutual action plan.

Vanessa (Redwood) -> delivery: entitlement_matrix.xlsx, network whitelist template, sample PO (sent 7/22).
StratusGrid -> deliver by 7/24 EOD Pacific: completed entitlement matrix, completed sample PO with legal entity and tax ID, network whitelist (or ASN note + expected NAT window), compliance proof (SOC2 redacted ok). Attachment: vendor_certifications.pdf received.
Naomi -> once packet received, finance will validate PO format and confirm Net30 vs Net45 (target within 48 hours of receipt).
Ben Carter -> I'll loop in marketplace operations for the technical onboarding call once we have the whitelist and entitlements (Ben, please prepare a 30-min intake call slot: propose 7/28 or 7/29).

Aisha — if you hit any blockers on IP ranges vs ASNs, flag that in the packet and we will triage on the intake call. Otherwise, we will expect the completed packet tomorrow and will coordinate the next technical onboarding slot.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
